<FILE_SYSTEM_GUIDELINES>

* For global search-and-replace operations, consider using `sed` instead of opening file editors multiple times.
* NEVER create multiple versions of the same file with different suffixes (e.g., file_test.py, file_fix.py, file_simple.py). Instead:
  - Always modify the original file directly when making changes

</FILE_SYSTEM_GUIDELINES>

<VERSION_CONTROL>

* When committing changes, use `git status` to see all modified files, and stage all files necessary for the commit. Use `git commit -a` whenever possible.
* Do NOT commit files that typically shouldn't go into version control (e.g., node_modules/, .env files, build directories, cache files, large binaries) unless explicitly instructed by the user.

</VERSION_CONTROL>

    52	How DVC works
    53	=============
    54

    61	#. ``Git/Git-lfs`` part - DVC helps you storing and sharing data artifacts, models. It connects them with your

   104	Installation
   105	============
   106	
   107	Read this `instruction <https://dvc.org/doc/get-started/install>`_ to get more details. There are four
   108	options to install DVC: ``pip``, Homebrew, Conda (Anaconda) or an OS-specific package:
   109	
   110	pip (PyPI)
   111	----------
   112	
   113	.. code-block:: bash
   114	
   115	   pip install dvc
   116	
   117	Depending on the remote storage type you plan to use to keep and share your data, you might need to specify
   118	one of the optional dependencies: ``s3``, ``gs``, ``azure``, ``oss``, ``ssh``. Or ``all`` to include them all.
   119	The command should look like this: ``pip install dvc[s3]`` - it installs the ``boto3`` library along with
   120	DVC to support the AWS S3 storage.
   121	
   122	To install the development version, run:
   123	
   124	.. code-block:: bash
   125	
   126	   pip install git+git://github.com/iterative/dvc
   127

   181	Related technologies
   182	====================
   183	
   184	#. `Git-annex <https://git-annex.branchable.com/>`_ - DVC uses the idea of storing the content of large files (that you
   185	   don't want to see in your Git repository) in a local key-value store and uses file hardlinks/symlinks instead of the
   186	   copying actual files.
   187	
   188	#. `Git-LFS <https://git-lfs.github.com/>`_ - DVC is compatible with any remote storage (S3, Google Cloud, Azure, SSH,
   189	   etc). DVC utilizes reflinks or hardlinks to avoid copy operation on checkouts which makes much more efficient for
   190	   large data files.
   191	
   192	#. *Makefile* (and its analogues). DVC tracks dependencies (DAG).
   193	
   194	#. `Workflow Management Systems <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Workflow_management_system>`_. DVC is a workflow
   195	   management system designed specifically to manage machine learning experiments. DVC is built on top of Git.
   196	
   197	#. `DAGsHub <https://dagshub.com/>`_ Is a Github equivalent for DVC - pushing your Git+DVC based repo to DAGsHub will give you a high level dashboard of your project, including DVC pipeline and metrics visualizations, as well as links to DVC managed files if they are in cloud storage.
